name: No-Fee Chequing Account
description: A no-fee everyday chequing account with unlimited transactions and free Interac e-Transfer. Includes a debit card with contactless tap-to-pay and access to thousands of ATMs nationwide.

name: Premium Chequing Account
description: Premium chequing with enhanced benefits including free certified cheques, preferred mortgage rates, and a bundled credit card fee waiver. Ideal for customers who want an all-in-one banking package.

name: Student Chequing Account
description: Free chequing for full-time students aged 18-25 with unlimited transactions, no minimum balance, and bonus rewards on textbook and transit purchases. Switch to a regular account anytime after graduation.

name: Senior Chequing Account
description: No-fee chequing designed for customers aged 60 and over. Includes free paper statements, in-branch priority service, and complimentary safety deposit box access. Unlimited transactions with no minimum balance.

name: US Dollar Chequing Account
description: Hold and transact in US dollars without repeated currency conversion fees. Perfect for cross-border shoppers, snowbirds, or anyone who receives US income. Includes a USD debit card for purchases in the United States.

name: High-Interest Savings Account
description: Earn a competitive interest rate on every dollar with no minimum balance required. Interest is calculated daily and paid monthly. Unlimited free transfers to your chequing account make it easy to access your money.

name: Youth Savings Account
description: Help kids aged 0-17 build saving habits with a bonus interest rate and no monthly fees. Parents can set up automatic deposits and savings goals. Converts to a regular savings account at age 18.

name: e-Savings Account
description: An online-only savings account offering a premium interest rate for digital-first customers. Manage your savings entirely through the mobile app or online banking. No paper statements, no branch visits needed.

name: Joint Savings Account
description: Save together with a joint account that gives both partners full access and visibility. Set shared savings goals for vacations, emergencies, or major purchases. Both account holders earn the same competitive rate.

name: US Dollar Savings Account
description: Earn interest on your US dollar holdings without conversion fees. Ideal for snowbirds, cross-border workers, or anyone saving in USD. Pairs perfectly with our US Dollar Chequing Account.

name: Cashback Rewards Credit Card
description: Earn unlimited cashback on every purchase — groceries, gas, dining, and more. No annual fee and no cap on rewards. Redeem your cashback as a statement credit, direct deposit, or towards travel.

name: Travel Rewards Credit Card
description: Earn accelerated points on travel, dining, and entertainment with complimentary airport lounge access. Includes comprehensive travel insurance, no foreign transaction fees, and a generous welcome bonus.

name: Low Rate Credit Card
description: Our lowest interest rate credit card, perfect for carrying a balance or consolidating debt from higher-rate cards. Includes a promotional balance transfer rate and no annual fee for the first year.

name: Student Credit Card
description: Build your credit history while you study. No annual fee, no income requirement, and cashback rewards on everyday spending. Includes free credit score monitoring and financial literacy resources.

name: Premium Credit Card
description: Our top-tier credit card with premium travel benefits, 24/7 concierge service, and the highest rewards earn rate. Includes comprehensive insurance coverage, global airport lounge access, and exclusive event invitations.

name: Contactless Rewards Credit Card
description: Tap to pay and earn rewards on every transaction. Designed for the modern consumer who values speed and convenience. Works with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay for seamless mobile payments.

name: Fixed Rate Mortgage
description: Lock in your rate for up to 5 years with predictable monthly payments. Choose from 1, 2, 3, or 5-year terms. Includes a 20% prepayment privilege and the option to increase your payment amount annually.

name: Variable Rate Mortgage
description: A variable rate mortgage that moves with prime, historically offering lower rates over the life of the mortgage. Convert to a fixed rate at any time with no penalty. Ideal for borrowers comfortable with rate fluctuations.

name: First-Time Home Buyer Mortgage
description: Special rates and flexible down payment options for first-time buyers. Cashback option to help with closing costs and moving expenses. Includes free home appraisal and dedicated mortgage advisor support.

name: Mortgage Renewal
description: Renew your mortgage with competitive rates and flexible terms. Switch from another lender with no legal fees. Explore options to access your home equity or adjust your payment schedule at renewal.

name: Home Equity Line of Credit
description: Access up to 65% of your home's appraised value with a revolving line of credit. Borrow and repay as needed with interest-only payments on the outstanding balance. Perfect for renovations, investments, or major expenses.

name: Construction Mortgage
description: Finance your custom home build with staged funding released as construction milestones are completed. Converts to a standard mortgage upon completion. Includes progress inspection coverage and flexible draw schedules.

name: Personal Loan
description: Borrow a fixed amount with predictable monthly payments and a competitive fixed rate. Use for debt consolidation, major purchases, or unexpected expenses. No collateral required for qualified borrowers.

name: Auto Loan
description: Finance your new or used vehicle with a competitive rate and flexible terms up to 8 years. Get pre-approved before you shop for added negotiating power at the dealership. Includes gap insurance options.

name: Debt Consolidation Loan
description: Combine multiple high-interest debts into a single lower-rate loan with one easy monthly payment. Reduce your total interest costs and pay off debt faster with a clear repayment timeline.

name: RRSP Loan
description: Maximize your RRSP contribution and tax deduction with a short-term loan at a special rate. Borrow up to your contribution limit and repay within 12 months. Use your tax refund to accelerate repayment.

name: Personal Line of Credit
description: Access funds whenever you need them with a revolving credit line. Pay interest only on what you use. Ideal as an emergency fund or for managing cash flow between pay periods.

name: Secured Line of Credit
description: Borrow at our lowest line-of-credit rate by securing against your home equity. Access up to 65% of your property value for renovations, investments, or major expenses. Interest-only minimum payments for maximum flexibility.

name: Student Line of Credit
description: Finance your education with a flexible credit line at prime rate. Interest-only payments while you study and a grace period after graduation. Access funds for tuition, books, living expenses, and study abroad programs.

name: 1-Year GIC
description: Lock in a guaranteed rate for 12 months with our most popular GIC term. Your principal is fully protected and eligible for CDIC deposit insurance. Choose interest paid at maturity or monthly.

name: Cashable GIC
description: Earn a guaranteed return with the flexibility to cash out after 30 days without penalty. Perfect when you want security but may need access to your funds. CDIC eligible up to applicable limits.

name: Long-Term GIC
description: Maximize your guaranteed return with a 3 or 5-year term at our highest GIC rate. Ideal for funds you won't need in the near term. Compound interest option available for accelerated growth.

name: Market-Linked GIC
description: Combine the safety of a guaranteed principal with the growth potential of stock market returns. Linked to a diversified market index with a guaranteed minimum return. Your original deposit is always protected.

name: Self-Directed Investment Account
description: Take control of your investments with access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, and mutual funds. Low commission trades, real-time market data, and powerful research tools. Available in registered (RRSP, TFSA) and non-registered accounts.

name: Managed Portfolio
description: Let our investment professionals manage a diversified portfolio tailored to your risk tolerance and goals. Automatic rebalancing, quarterly performance reports, and access to institutional-grade funds not available to retail investors.

name: Mutual Fund Account
description: Invest in a curated selection of mutual funds across equity, fixed income, and balanced mandates. Start with as little as $500 and set up automatic contributions. Includes professional fund management and annual tax reporting.

name: Index Fund Portfolio
description: A low-cost, passively managed portfolio that tracks major market indexes. Benefit from broad market diversification with some of the lowest management fees available. Ideal for long-term, buy-and-hold investors.

name: RRSP (Retirement Savings Plan)
description: Reduce your taxable income today while building your retirement nest egg. Contributions are tax-deductible and investments grow tax-deferred until withdrawal. Choose from GICs, mutual funds, stocks, and ETFs within your RRSP.

name: TFSA (Tax-Free Savings Account)
description: Grow your savings and investments completely tax-free. Withdrawals are tax-free and contribution room is restored the following year. Hold savings, GICs, stocks, ETFs, or mutual funds — all sheltered from tax.

name: RESP (Education Savings Plan)
description: Save for your child's post-secondary education with government grants of up to 20% on your contributions. Investments grow tax-sheltered until withdrawal for qualified educational expenses. Open for a child from birth.

name: FHSA (First Home Savings Account)
description: Save up to $40,000 tax-free for your first home. Contributions are tax-deductible like an RRSP and withdrawals for a qualifying home purchase are tax-free like a TFSA. The best of both registered plans for first-time buyers.

name: Business Chequing Account
description: A full-featured business chequing account with unlimited transactions, free incoming wire transfers, and integrated payroll services. Manage payables, receivables, and cash flow from a single business banking dashboard.

name: Business Savings Account
description: Earn competitive interest on idle business funds with no minimum balance. Set up automatic sweeps from your business chequing to maximize returns on surplus cash. Fully liquid with same-day access to your funds.

name: Business Credit Card
description: Earn rewards on business spending with detailed expense tracking and reporting. Issue supplementary cards for employees with individual spending limits. Integrates with major accounting software for easy reconciliation.

name: Commercial Mortgage
description: Finance the purchase or refinance of commercial property including office space, retail locations, and industrial buildings. Flexible amortization up to 25 years with competitive fixed and variable rate options.

name: Business Line of Credit
description: Manage cash flow gaps and seasonal fluctuations with a revolving business credit line. Draw and repay as needed with interest only on the outstanding balance. Available secured or unsecured based on your business profile.

name: Merchant Services Account
description: Accept credit, debit, and contactless payments in-store and online. Competitive processing rates, next-day settlement, and a free POS terminal for qualifying businesses. Integrates with popular e-commerce platforms.

name: Home Insurance Policy
description: Comprehensive home insurance covering your dwelling, personal property, and liability. Protects against fire, theft, water damage, and weather events.

name: Auto Insurance Bundle
description: Bundle your auto and home insurance for a multi-policy discount. Includes liability, collision, and comprehensive coverage with optional roadside assistance.

name: Property Listing Service
description: Full-service real estate listing and marketing for residential properties. Includes professional photography, virtual tours, and MLS listing placement.

name: Tax Filing Package
description: Professional tax preparation and filing for individuals and small businesses. Maximizes deductions and credits with CRA-certified electronic filing.

name: Bookkeeping Service
description: Monthly bookkeeping and financial record management for small businesses. Includes bank reconciliation, accounts payable tracking, and quarterly financial statements.

name: Estate Planning Consultation
description: Comprehensive estate planning consultation including wills, powers of attorney, and trust establishment. Protect your assets and ensure your wishes are carried out.
